title: Furanocoumarins promote proteasomal degradation of viral HBx protein and down-regulate cccDNA transcription and replication of hepatitis B virus.
authors: Tyagi, Purnima; Singh, Ankita; Kumar, Jitendra; Ahmad, Belal; Bahuguna, Aparna; Vivekanandan, Perumal; Sarin, Shiv Kumar; Kumar, Vijay
one_liner_zh: 该文研究呋喃香豆素通过蛋白酶体降解HBx蛋白抑制乙肝病毒cccDNA转录，分子对接仅作为辅助验证，核心是抗病毒药物机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Nucleot(s)ide analogues, the current antiviral treatments against chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection, are non-curative due to their inability to eliminate covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA) from the infected hepatocytes. Preclinical studies have shown that coumarin derivatives can effectively reduce the HBV DNA replication. We evaluated the antiviral efficacy of thirty new coumarin derivatives in cell culture models for studying HBV. Furanocoumarins Fc-20 and Fc-31 suppressed the levels of pre-genomic RNA as well as cccDNA, and reduced the secretion of virions, HBsAg and HBeAg. The antiviral efficacies of Fc-20 and Fc31 improved further when used in combination with the hepatitis B antiviral drug Entecavir. There was a marked reduction in the intracellular HBx level in the presence of these furanocoumarins due to proteasomal degradation resulting in the down-regulation of HBx-dependent viral genes. Importantly, both Fc-20 and Fc-31 were non-cytotoxic to cells even at high concentrations. Further, our molecular docking studies confirmed a moderate to high affinity interaction between furanocoumarins and viral HBx via residues Ala3, Arg26 and Lys140. These data suggest that furanocoumarins could be developed as a new therapeutic for CHB infection.
abstract_zh: 核苷（酸）类似物，目前针对慢性乙型肝炎（CHB）感染的抗病毒治疗，因无法从受感染的肝细胞中消除共价闭合环状DNA（cccDNA）而不能治愈。临床前研究表明，香豆素衍生物能有效降低HBV DNA复制。我们在研究HBV的细胞培养模型中评估了三十种新型香豆素衍生物的抗病毒效力。呋喃香豆素Fc-20和Fc-31抑制了前基因组RNA及cccDNA的水平，并减少了病毒颗粒、HBsAg和HBeAg的分泌。当与乙肝抗病毒药物恩替卡韦联合使用时，Fc-20和Fc-31的抗病毒效力进一步提高。在这些呋喃香豆素存在下，细胞内HBx水平显著降低，这是由于蛋白酶体降解导致HBx依赖性病毒基因下调。重要的是，即使在高浓度下，Fc-20和Fc-31对细胞也无细胞毒性。此外，我们的分子对接研究确认了呋喃香豆素与病毒HBx之间通过残基Ala3、Arg26和Lys140存在中等到高亲和力的相互作用。这些数据表明，呋喃香豆素可被开发为治疗CHB感染的新型疗法。
